vulnerability_mechanism.evidence: The advisory and clone agree on the complete path: an editor of local-path-config controls helperPod.yaml; loadHelperPodFile YAML-to-JSON decodes it into v1.Pod without security-field validation; createHelperPod DeepCopies that pod and submits it on a target node, preserving attacker-supplied privileged securityContext, hostPath volumes, capabilities, host namespaces, service account, and executable hooks.

atomic_bic.evidence: git log -L for loadHelperPodFile starts at 874088575ce38ca3fab3ed774e731c1c3b571dc8. Its diff simultaneously adds the unvalidated decoder, reads helperPod.yaml from the ConfigMap, stores the decoded pod, and replaces the fixed helper construction with p.helperPod.DeepCopy(); this is the smallest public first-write of the vulnerable sink.

immediate_parent_absence.evidence: 874088575ce38ca3fab3ed774e731c1c3b571dc8 has the single immediate parent c3192ec3f19f2bdb84a13a830d4160f44963c92c. That tree has no util.go and no loadHelperPodFile, helperPod.yaml, or FlagHelperPodFile match; createHelperPod constructs a fixed Pod in Go instead of accepting an attacker-controlled pod spec.

squash_member_decomposition.evidence: The BIC is a non-merge single-parent commit. The exact PR #127 remote head is 33c1c20db4ad05766fe65d42932caf3bdf7aadcd, and the PR patch exposes one From/Subject entry with the same change title; public main history contains one rebased first-write rather than a squash aggregate needing member decomposition.

affected_and_fixed_release_membership.evidence: CVE.org records versions < 0.0.36 as affected and 0.0.36 as fixed. Clone ancestry independently shows the BIC absent from v0.0.17 and present from v0.0.18 through v0.0.36; fix 28710fb09df4ab694f8e256983dfbd6e50da46c7 is absent from v0.0.34 and v0.0.35 and present in v0.0.36. This resolves the contradictory advisory prose mentioning v0.0.34 in favor of the structured range and repository history.

direct_fix_or_verified_unpatched_state.evidence: 28710fb09df4ab694f8e256983dfbd6e50da46c7 directly inserts validateHelperPodTemplate into both startup and hot-reload decoding and rejects unsafe pod/container fields by default. Follow-up 73c6566c1f5f63bfbf98cec5720a2bc5549fdc6a narrows blanket securityContext rejection to dangerous fields while retaining the privilege-escalation barriers; both commits are in v0.0.36.

bic_only_ai_attribution.evidence: AI attribution was evaluated only on BIC 874088575ce38ca3fab3ed774e731c1c3b571dc8. Its commit object names human author nicktming <2279563278@qq.com> and human committer Sheng Yang <sheng@yasker.org>, and its message has no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, Made-with, bot identity, or other AI marker.

findings: CVE-2026-44543 is PUBLISHED, not withdrawn or rejected, so FALSE_POSITIVE does not apply.
The primary correctly identifies 874088575ce38ca3fab3ed774e731c1c3b571dc8 as the atomic BIC and c3192ec3f19f2bdb84a13a830d4160f44963c92c as its verified clean immediate parent.
The primary correctly uses the structured advisory range and Git ancestry to identify v0.0.36, not the contradictory v0.0.34 prose, as the first fixed release.
The primary NOT_AI verdict is supported by BIC-only attribution evidence.
